subject: general
question: Swachhata Pakhwada is an initiative of which ministry, and what is its primary objective?

options.text: Ministry of Home Affairs; To improve border security
Ministry of Jal Shakti; To bring intense focus on cleanliness across all Union Ministries
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs; To build smart cities
Ministry of Earth Sciences; To monitor climate change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Jal Shakti; To bring intense focus on cleanliness across all Union Ministries.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Steel and its PSUs observed ‘Swachhata Pakhwada’ from 16th to 31st March 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swachhata Pakhwada aims to engage all Union Ministries and Departments in Swachhata (cleanliness) related activities.**
 
• It is an initiative under **Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen).**
 
• It was launched in **April 2016** with the objective of bringing about an intense focus on sanitation issues and practices by involving all Ministries and Departments of Government of India. Every year an annual calendar is circulated in advance to help plan the fortnight activities among Ministries/Departments.
 
• The Ministry of Jal Shakti is the nodal ministry that manages the annual Pakhwada calendar.
 
• The objective is to provide a **fortnight (15 days)** of intense focus on cleanliness issues and practices within the specific jurisdiction of each ministry.
 
• Implementation Details__
 __
 
• Nodal Department- Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS)
 
• Frequency - Once a year for each Ministry as per a pre-decided calendar
 
• Scope - Includes office premises, townships, schools, and nearby villages
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM)__

 __
 
• Launch Date - 2nd October 2014.
 
• Aim - To achieve a clean and Open Defecation Free (ODF) India.
 
 
 
• Swachhata Action Plan (SAP)__
 __
 
• A mainstreaming strategy where ministries earmark a specific budget for cleanliness activities relevant to their sector.
 
 
 
• Recent Context (Steel Ministry)__
 
 
• Observed March 16–31, 2026, focusing on slag reduction and gaseous waste recycling.
